canonical_title: MediaTek launches Dimensity 9600 Pro with 2nm process and upgraded on-device AI NPU
treatment: Repeat only for shipping devices, independent NPU benchmarks, detailed AI model capability, or material data-center accelerator milestones.
known_facts: MediaTek launched Dimensity 9600 Pro, its first smartphone processor on TSMC's 2nm process, alongside the 3nm Dimensity 9600M.
MediaTek says the 9600 Pro NPU improves prompt-processing performance by 51% versus the prior generation, without publishing detailed methodology.
MediaTek expects its first AI accelerator for a major U.S. cloud provider to enter mass production in Q4 2026.
reinclude_only_if: Independent on-device generative-AI benchmarks become available.
First shipping smartphone implementations materially clarify capability or efficiency.
MediaTek identifies or materially updates its U.S. cloud AI accelerator program.
notes: The 51% NPU figure is vendor-reported and lacks detailed methodology.
